Gemini Watermark Remover

Removes the small Gemini/AI badge that Google's Gemini & Imagen models stamp in a corner of generated images — runs 100% in your browser, nothing is uploaded anywhere.

Note: this inverts the known, fixed visual badge overlay. It does not strip SynthID's invisible statistical watermark, which isn't removable this way.
